seo.title: Services — VIKUB
seo.description: VIKUB helps Italian companies enter Belarus and the Eurasian Economic Union: market research, investment, retail, legal support and payment solutions.

title: What we do
lead: We help Italian businesses understand markets, find partners and assess risks — before making a decision.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.text: We discuss your goal, product and expectations.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.text: We examine the request, assess all regulatory requirements and rule out unrealistic scenarios.

steps.title: Finding opportunities
steps.text: We find projects and partners that match your strategy.

steps.title: Contacts
steps.text: We arrange meetings and prepare you for negotiations.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.text: We bring in specialists and support the transaction through to completion.

expertSupport.title: Lawyers, tax advisers and logistics specialists — for your project
paragraphs: We do not give generic advice. We assemble a specialist team for each task: Italian and Belarusian lawyers, tax advisers, accountants, and certification and logistics experts.
All are vetted, and we have worked with many of them for years. You receive more than a consultation: you get a project team ready to work.
